# routeros_ip_firewall_service_port (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_firewall_service_port" "sip" {
  name     = "sip"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item to configure.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ports` (String) Port numbers, comma separated.
- `sip_direct_media` (Boolean)
- `sip_timeout` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean)
